# Mauricio Moya

> Finance leader with an MBA and AI agent engineer. Builds the systems that run finance: FP&A, budgeting and forecasting, cash flow, receivables, funding strategy, internal controls and grant compliance, plus the automation, dashboards and AI agents that cut cost and manual work. Twenty years in finance, operations and software. Open to roles and consulting.

Skills: FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, cash flow, accounts receivable, funding strategy, internal controls, audit readiness, grant compliance, finance automation, AI agents, agent skills for Claude Code, evals, Python, SQL, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, ERP systems, dashboards, data analysis, SaaS, university teaching.

Contact: LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/mba-mmoyat/ (the best way to reach him about roles, consulting or products).

## Pages

- [Portfolio](https://maumoya.github.io/): overview, open-source agent skills with measured results, browser games, products
- [Development](https://maumoya.github.io/development/): AI agent engineering, skills and workflows measured with evals and shipped
- [Finance](https://maumoya.github.io/finance/): FP&A, cash flow, receivables and funding strategy on clean data and automation
- [Compliance](https://maumoya.github.io/compliance/): internal controls, grant compliance, audit readiness and security
- [Education](https://maumoya.github.io/education/): university teaching, data tutoring and AI workshops

## Experience

- Director of Finance, ECDC, Vermont, USA (2026 to now). Before that Senior Finance Officer and Finance Officer there (2024 to 2026). Reimbursements cut from 90+ days to about 30, receivables from $300K+ to about $60K, payroll allocation from 16 hours to 3.
- Teaching assistant and data analysis tutor, Hult International Business School (2023 to 2025). 180+ students tutored.
- Business analysis and strategy internships, Lionchase North America and Boston Innovation Gateway (2022 to 2023). Due diligence on a $100M private equity deal.
- Finance and operations manager, Gestiona365, Lima, Peru (2019 to 2021); CFO and co-founder, SMARTECH latam. Operating costs down 9% two years running.
- Branch manager and founding partner, New Voltage X Fit (2017 to 2018). Breakeven in year one.
- Facility manager, JLL (2008 to 2014), then university professor, UPC (2015 to 2016).

Resume (PDF): https://maumoya.github.io/resume.pdf

Full history: https://maumoya.github.io/#career and https://www.linkedin.com/in/mba-mmoyat/
